other_failure_modes.name: Leakage via Full-Dataset Frequency Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes frequency encoding on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the marginal distribution of categorical variables from the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent's solution correctly identifies the task structure and performs decent feature engineering. However, it critically fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random StratifiedKFold instead of a time-based split, which will yield overly optimistic validation scores. Additionally, frequency encoding is computed on the combined train and test sets, subtly leaking test distribution information into the training data.
